_readme: Chord rhythm library. To add a pattern: copy any entry, change name/tags/bars. Each bar is 16 characters, one per 16th note: X accent, x normal, o soft re-attack, . ghost, - rest. 'hold' = how long each hit rings, in 16ths (1.6 is the old short stab). Keep hits at least 2 steps apart. Entries can have 1-4 bars; the engine mixes two entries across a slot. Used only by beats made after 2026-10-11 (chord_flow beats); older beats rebuild exactly as they were. A DJ can favor tags with 'pattern_tags': {"bounce": 3} in its chord_grammar. Entries with "v": 2 (added 2026-10-19) are only used by beats stamped chord_lib 2, so beats made before that rebuild exactly as they were.
